fields.label: Cloud Provider
fields.description: AWS account this network belongs to. Blank for a bare-metal placeholder.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: A VPC cannot span regions. Blank for a bare-metal placeholder — a linked Machine's own Region is left alone.

fields.label: Availability Zone
fields.description: e.g. ap-south-1a. The subnet's AZ. Required for Create Network.

fields.label: Machine Image
fields.description: Default AMI id for Machines launched into this Network, e.g. ami-0abc123. AMI ids are region-scoped, so this lives here rather than on Cloud Provider — one per region, not one per account. A Machine's own Machine Image overrides this.

fields.label: CIDR Block
fields.description: VPC CIDR, e.g. 10.0.0.0/16. Auto-assigned to the next unused /16 in 10.0.0.0/8 on save when a Cloud Provider is set and this is left blank — every Network gets a distinct range, so VPCs can be peered later without an overlap. Required for Create Network.

fields.label: Subnet CIDR Block
fields.description: Subnet CIDR within the VPC, e.g. 10.0.0.0/24. Required for Create Network.

fields.label: VPC ID
fields.description: AWS VPC id. Blank + CIDR Block/Subnet CIDR Block/Availability Zone set = Create Network can make one for you. Otherwise paste an existing VPC's id here.

fields.label: Subnet ID
fields.description: The subnet Machines in this group launch into. Filled in by Create Network, or paste an existing subnet's id.

fields.label: Internet Gateway ID
fields.description: Filled in by Create Network. Informational.

fields.label: Route Table ID
fields.description: Filled in by Create Network. Informational — the VPC's own default route table, given a 0.0.0.0/0 route to the Internet Gateway.

fields.label: Proxy Security Group IDs
fields.description: Comma-separated, e.g. sg-abc,sg-def. For a Proxy Server box: 22, 80 and 443 open to 0.0.0.0/0. Blank + a VPC ID = Create Security Groups can make one for you.

fields.label: Inference Security Group IDs
fields.description: Comma-separated, e.g. sg-abc,sg-def. For an Inference Server box: 22 open to 0.0.0.0/0, 8080-8085 (engine ports) open only to the Proxy security group — 6 ports, so at most 6 concurrent Model Deployments per box. Blank + a VPC ID = Create Security Groups can make one for you.
